sources: Microsoft Learn: 'netsh interface ip' (set dnsservers, add dnsservers, source=dhcp). Only active physical adapters are changed (no VPN or virtual adapters); the previous state of each adapter (automatic or fixed servers) is backed up and restored exactly when resetting.
Addresses from the Cloudflare documentation '1.1.1.1 - Set up' (developers.cloudflare.com).
The description does not promise a speed gain; whether another DNS provider answers faster depends on your location (ping test under Tools).
